ct_left_leg.blurb: Left Leg is a small bouldering zone inside Sleeping Giant State Park in Hamden, Connecticut, where the problems are scattered through talus on the hillside. Ten problems span roughly V0 to V7, with a few easy ones, a middle group around V2 and V3, one V5 and a pair of hard testpieces at the top end. The stone has good friction and texture, and a number of lines finish on tall, steep arete and slab faces. A marked park trail runs past the whole cluster, so most of the boulders can be spotted from the path.

ct_old_mill_lane_boulder_field.blurb: Old Mill Lane Boulder Field sits in the quiet northern end of Mianus Park on the Connecticut side of the Greenwich and Stamford line. Roughly half a dozen worthwhile boulders stand in an uphill clearing, holding ten problems that run from very easy up to V7, with most falling in the V1 to V4 range. Blocks are mostly 8 to 12 feet tall, with a mix of slabs, traverses and overhanging faces. It sees little traffic, and the boulders dry fairly well, though that depends on which block you pick.
